rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a professional who cuts or styles hair.

example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 faat3 jing4 si1

rows.note: Use this more formal term when emphasizing someone whose occupation is cutting hair, especially in a barbering context.

example.english: This hairdresser specializes in shaving customers’ beards.
example.traditional: 呢位理髮師專門替客人剃鬚。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai2 lei5 faat3 si1 zyun1 mun4 tai3 haak3 jan4 tai3 sou1
